name: ribosome binding protein 1

function.text: RRBP1 encodes ribosome-binding protein 1. Annotated molecular activities include signaling receptor activity. It participates in translation and osteoblast differentiation.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Epithelioid inflammatory myofibroblastic sarcoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
